### Data

The data used in this post comes from the [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/).

The dataset contains measurements for penguins from three species observed in Antarctica.

```{python}
#| label: Import the packages

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

penguins = load_penguins()
penguins.head()
```

### Question

Which penguin species has the highest average body mass?

### First step

We only need the `body_mass_g` variable for this analysis, so we remove rows where body mass is missing.

This step ensures that missing values do not affect the calculation of average body mass.

```{python}

clean_data = penguins.dropna(subset=["body_mass_g"])

clean_data.head()

```

### Second Step

Next, we group the penguins by species and calculate the average body mass for each species.

```{python}
mean_mass = (
    clean_data
    .groupby("species")["body_mass_g"]
    .mean()
    .reset_index(name="mean_body_mass_g")
)

mean_mass

```

### Third Step

We sort the results from highest to lowest average body mass so that we can identify which species has the largest average body mass.

```{python}

mean_mass_sorted = mean_mass.sort_values(
    "mean_body_mass_g",
    ascending=False
)

mean_mass_sorted

```

### Last Step

Finally, we create a bar chart to compare the average body mass across species.

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass
#| fig-cap: "Average body mass by penguin species."

plt.bar(
    mean_mass_sorted["species"],
    mean_mass_sorted["mean_body_mass_g"]
);

plt.xlabel("Species");
plt.ylabel("Average body mass (g)");
plt.show()
```

### Findings

The results show that Gentoo penguins have the highest average body mass.

The bar chart makes the differences in average body mass between the three penguin species easier to compare visually.
